notes.title: New map teaser: House
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

I come with the greatest happiness to announce the teaser of the new map:

[previewyoutube=s_mOTEK_2W0;full][/previewyoutube]

In addition to the new map, the game will undergo a HUGE gameplay overhaul:

[list]
[*] Movement without inertia
[*] New animations
[*] Improved disk space usage
[*] Improved network usage
[/list]

The new map should come out soon, in addition to other joint fixes.

Thanks for giving our game a try!

Happy 2023!

notes.title: DevLog #01
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

First of all, I'd like to thank all players that suggested new features and gave some feedback reporting bugs.

[b]If you still haven't reported the bugs that you found, I ask you to please, report it on Steam Forums or on our Discord[/b]. We have fixed more than 90% of the bugs that have been reported, and will continue. But your reports REALLY help us.

On this DevLog, I'd like to introduce you to our new map:

[b]The Old House[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42154181/89d7b95e90e6c4354987ade93167bc6cc3ffcbab.png[/img]

[b]This map will have a UNIQUE gameplay style, with a slower pace, ditching the 'speak to see' style from the Temple.[/b]

The ritual will be different, the pace will be different, and, most important of all, the enemy will be different, including it's behavior.

Overall, more features will be added along with the updates, and our plan of daily updates (even if it's minor performance improvements/bug fixes) will go on.

notes.title: There Won't be Light has been released with 15% discount!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce the release of There Won't Be Light!

The game will be on [b]15% discount[/b] throughout one week, so be sure to check that out!

This first version shows the base of our idea with plenty of room for future improvement. We are looking forward to receiving feedback from players.
We also have a roadmap showing what we still want to achieve with the game. 

[b]There Won't Be Light[/b]

The game is set in a ancient dark maze where the only source of light is activated by the player's voice. One must be careful to control their voice, in order to avoid drawing the attention of the ancient spawns. A ritual must be complete by the players to grant their victory. As you finish steps of the rituals, new dangers come up...

There is a single player mode, and a co-op mode, where you can count on help from your friends!

Be sure to join our Discord and check our Roadmap, so you can keep on track of what's coming and what bugs we are aware!

notes.title: There Won't be Light: new features and release date set to 23th September!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

As our Playtest has finished, we gathered a lot of feedback from your tests, and we are implementing all new features and fixing the bugs. First of all, let's jump into the features that will be available with the game's release on Early Access:

[list]
[*] Purge Mode (Cooperative up to 5 players): Beware of the entity in the darkness. In this cooperative mode, you and your friends must complete the ritual while the monster hunts you. But beware of your voice, since whomever that lies in the shadows [b]will hear you[/b].
[*] Flashlight mode: Our game uses your voice as a light mode. But sometimes, you just want to play the classic way. The flashlight mode changes the session to a flashlight as your light, and the voice just a VoIP feature.
[/list]

We will also be removing the Possessed mode until further tests make it more stable. Many people enjoyed it, but we are not satisfied with the results yet. When it's in a better state, we will bring it back.

Last, but not least, [b]There Won't be Light is set to be released by 23th September, with the price of $4.99[/b] (or the equivalent regional price set by Steam).

But, even though it's the release, we need your opinion, because your feedback is still crucial! Your feedback allowed us to better tune our game and find bugs to fix them. The game is set to be released in Early Access, and it's your opinion that will allow us to better improve our game!

We hope you enjoy the game, and stay tuned for more info!

notes.title: There Won't be Light Playtest has been released!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I'm pleased to announce that the Playtest for There Won't be Light has been released! For the first day, the access will be released in batches for testers. As the bugs are fixed, we will grant access for more players.

The Playtest will last for 4 days. It has the core features for the game, with one map available. There are already known bugs, and they will be fixed over the next days.

If you wish to keep up with the infos on the Playtest, join our Discord on the Steam Store page!
